lines.text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the Bowl!
Twenty cars! One survivor! Let's make some noise!
Welcome, derby fans! Only the toughest car drives home!
Twenty cars in the Bowl, and none of them leave pretty!
Good evening, and welcome to the derby! Hold on to your hats!
Simple rules, folks! Hit hard, spin them, stay alive!
Let's get it on!
Go, go, go!
And they're off! Here comes the carnage!
Floor it! Let the demolition begin!
Here we go! Pedal to the metal!
What a crunch in the middle! Nobody got out clean!
The big pile-up in the centre! Metal everywhere!
And there's the first big smash! The crowd loves it!
Wow! A wall of wreckage right in the middle of the Bowl!
Ooh, what a hit!
That's gonna leave a mark!
Bang! Right in the door!
Massive hit!
Crunch! Somebody felt that one!
What a wallop!
Ouch! Did you hear that?
Smash! The crowd is on its feet!
Sheet metal is flying!
That one rattled the grandstand!
Oh my, that's a big one!
Talk about a body blow!
Boom! Right on target!
Now that's how you hit a car!
Somebody's going to need a new paint job!
Great hit, number seven!
You really nailed that one!
Wham! Number seven means business!
Beautiful shot! Right in the side!
Ooh, you made them pay for that!
Now that's a hit! Keep it up!
You folded that car like a deck chair!
Number seven, delivering the goods!
Textbook hit! The crowd loves you!
Bullseye! What a hit from number seven!
Head-on! Oh, that was enormous!
Oh my word! Nose to nose at full speed!
What a collision! I felt that one up here in the booth!
Unbelievable! Two cars, one almighty bang!
That's the hit of the night, folks!
You spun them round! Nice!
Spin! Points for number seven!
Round they go! Lovely work!
Nice spin! The points are rolling in!
You sent that car twirling!
Look at that one spin! Great driving!
A perfect tap, and away they spin!
That's a spinner! Well done, seven!
Spun right round! The judges like that!
Clip the back, watch them spin! Beautiful!
All the way round!
A full three-sixty! Incredible!
Round, and round, and round! What a spin!
They went all the way round! Spectacular!
You wrecked them! What a finish!
That car is going nowhere, thanks to you!
Number seven claims another victim!
Lights out! You finished them off!
One less car in the Bowl, courtesy of number seven!
You put that one out of its misery!
Another wreck! Number seven is on a rampage!
That's scrap metal now! Great work!
That car is done for!
And that's the end of that one!
Totally wrecked! Off to the scrap yard!
Out of the derby! That car is finished!
Steam, smoke, and silence! That one's out!
Another one for the scrap heap!
Game over for that car!
They're out! Somebody fetch the tow truck!
That one won't be driving home tonight!
Down goes another one!
Whoa, you got spun round!
Round you go! Shake it off, seven!
They spun you! Get back in it!
Uh oh, number seven is facing the wrong way!
You've lost your hood!
There goes your hood!
Your bonnet's gone flying!
You've lost your bumper!
There goes the bumper! Never mind, it's only trim!
Bumper's gone! Not that you needed it!
You've lost a wheel!
There goes a wheel! Hang on to that steering!
Your wheel is rolling away without you!
Three wheels and a prayer, number seven!
You're on fire!
Number seven is on fire! Keep moving!
Flames! Your car is on fire!
Fire! Better make this count, seven!
You're smoking, number seven!
Smoke pouring out of number seven! Careful now!
That engine's smoking! Not long left!
There goes your windscreen!
Glass everywhere! Can you still see out of that thing?
Your windows are history!
Your front end is history! Turn round and use your rear!
Front's gone, seven! Go backwards, save that engine!
Front end in pieces! Reverse into them!
Your rear end is hanging by a thread!
The back end can't take much more! Mind your rear!
Your side's caved in! Protect those doors!
That door can't take another hit, seven!
There go your headlights!
Lights out up front, seven! Drive by feel!
Oh no! Number seven is out!
That's it for you! Your car is finished!
You're wrecked! What a valiant effort!
Game over, number seven! Better luck next time!
Number seven has had it! The crowd salutes you!
Your derby is done! Give that car a round of applause!
Over it goes! A rollover!
Upside down! What a sight!
Wheels in the air! It's gone right over!
It's on its roof! The crowd goes wild!
We have a new leader!
Change at the top of the scoreboard!
A new car takes the lead on points!
Look at the scoreboard! New leader!
Number seven leads! Everyone's coming for you now!
You're top of the scoreboard! Watch your back!
You're the leader! That's a target on your back!
You're in the lead! Now they all want a piece of you!
They're ganging up on you, seven!
Look out! The whole pack is after you!
Everybody wants number seven! Get out of there!
Backwards into them! Textbook!
Reverse ram! Engine safe, smart driving!
Rear end first! That's how the pros do it!
Back it up, and bang! Beautiful!
Pile-up! Cars everywhere!
What a tangle! Who's on top of who?
Three, four, five cars in one big heap!
Come on, get stuck in!
The crowd wants action!
Somebody hit somebody!
Don't be shy, drivers! Find a target!
We didn't come here to watch a parade!
Wake up out there! Let's see some contact!
Is this a derby or a Sunday drive?
Plenty of cars left to hit, folks!
Ten cars left in the Bowl!
We're down to ten! Half the field is scrap!
Five cars left!
Only five survivors! This is getting serious!
Down to the final five!
Three cars left!
Just three remain! Who wants it most?
Final three! Every hit counts now!
It's down to the last two!
Two cars left! One more hit could do it!
Head to head for the win! The crowd is on its feet!
Two left standing! This is it!
Number seven is the last car running! You win!
You did it! Champion of the Bowl!
The last car standing is number seven! What a performance!
Victory for number seven! Take a bow!
What a night of destruction! Let's look at the scores!
That's the derby done! Here are your results!
Thank you, derby fans! See you next time in the Bowl!
